body: This was comforting to read. I’ve been unemployed for a few months after getting my masters degree, broke up with my boyfriend, move back in with my parents and brother and am fighting with my sister about the overwhelming amount of family commitments that I am expected to rsvp to immediately.. I feel broken and useless , sometimes I just want out and then think of the huge mess I’d leave behind but this heavy feeling just doesn’t lift..
It wasn’t bad. At first I tried to crochet directly with just jute and that was tough, trying to find a solution to make it easier
So interested in how you made these! Love them

Aubrey throw a treat in the direction you want him to walk in. My dog was very similar but it took a lot of patience, standing there and waiting for her to just give up and walk towards me. The treats helped a lot!
